corrections.new:
REFUSED AT CONNECT, NOT TRUSTED AT RUNTIME. The store asks the server for its
`maxmemory-policy` and refuses to open at all unless the answer is `noeviction`. Every
`volatile-*` and `allkeys-*` policy is refused by name, case-insensitively because the reply
is a server string rather than a token this code chose. **A policy it could not read is
refused too**: an empty reply, an error, a renamed `CONFIG` — an unverifiable policy is not
evidence of a safe one.

THE WINDOW IS A WINDOW. The `PX` TTL is the retention horizon plus the declared replica clock divergence
bound, minus `now` read from the store's OWN clock, never an absolute epoch, and it clamps to a
minimal value rather than going negative when the instant has already passed. The padding is what
makes the window safe for a replica whose clock runs ahead of a correct one: the record is kept to
the verifier's horizon in true time for every clock within the declared bound, and that the actual
divergence is within the bound is ASM-0061. An already-stale `retain_until` is refused BEFORE Redis
is touched, judged on the unpadded horizon.

THE DECLARED TIER IS ENFORCED, NOT AUDITED. Where `REDIS_WAIT_QUORUM` is selected, a fresh
insert is followed by `WAIT`, and an acknowledgement shortfall FAILS CLOSED — it does not
report the nonce fresh and note the shortfall.

EVERY NON-ANSWER IS AN OUTAGE. A stall is bounded by a timeout rather than hanging; a refused
endpoint fails closed at construction rather than after the deadline; a transient error is
retried only where retry is safe and a fatal one is not retried at all; a reconnect that
itself fails, fails closed. Connect attempts that were abandoned are bounded by a ceiling
which also fails closed, and one stalled connect strands at most one permit. No path returns
`Fresh`.

corrections.new:
NOTHING ABOUT DURABILITY. What an acknowledged `SET NX` durably established is ASM-0040, a
foreign premise with its documented failover caveat — `REDIS_WAIT_QUORUM` is not linearizable
replay durability and is not a guarantee that every later failover preserves the nonce.
Nothing here restates it or strengthens it, and this theorem is not evidence for it.

NOT A LIVENESS CLAIM: it says no failure becomes a `Fresh`, never that a healthy Redis
answers.

THE POLICY IS ASSERTED AT CONNECT, ON EVERY CONNECTION, AND NOT AFTERWARDS. Each pooled
connection asks the server it reached, so a URL that resolves to a different server per
connection is refused if any of them evicts. A server whose policy is changed underneath a
live connection, or a failover or reconnect that lands a live connection on a different
server, is not detected by this mechanism, and nothing here claims otherwise. What covers
that is ASM-0059 — every server reachable at the replay URL, failover targets and
replacements included, runs `noeviction` for as long as it serves the tier — an operator
premise this claim rests on rather than establishes. The connect-time refusal is what stops a
misconfigured deployment from starting rather than what stops one from being reconfigured.

The `WAIT` conjunct governs the tier the store was BUILT with. That the tier a deployment
DECLARED is the tier the store was built with is `app.rs`'s composition and THM-0092's
subject, not this one's.

corrections.new:
ONE LINEARIZED ADMISSION. The record is a `v3/kv/txn` comparing `CREATE_REVISION == 0` and
PUTting the key under a lease iff it does not yet exist. Etcd linearizes the transaction, so
two racing inserts cannot both observe the key absent: `succeeded` is `Fresh`, and
not-`succeeded` is `Replay`.

THE LEASE IS BOUNDED, AND IS A WINDOW. The lease TTL is the retention horizon plus the declared
replica clock divergence bound, minus `now` on the store's OWN clock, clamped to a minimal value
rather than going negative, so a replica whose clock runs ahead of a correct one still keeps the
record to the verifier's horizon in true time (the bound being true is ASM-0061). A recorded nonce
self-expires at that padded horizon even if the proxy dies. An already-stale `retain_until`
is refused with NO etcd call at all. Nonces retained to the same instant share one lease, so
the outstanding-lease count grows with the freshness window rather than with request volume,
and an expired lease is never reused.

THE LEASE A REPLAY DID NOT USE IS GIVEN BACK. A `Replay` revokes the lease it minted and did
not consume; a `Fresh` keeps it. A revoke that FAILS still answers `Replay` and never an
error — the nonce's status is already known, and turning lease hygiene into a refusal would
convert a bookkeeping failure into a denial of service.

FAIL CLOSED, AND BOUNDED. A lease id that is missing, zero or unparseable is refused. Every
transport, status, parse or TIMEOUT outcome is `Unavailable`. The per-operation deadline is
clamped at BOTH ends and applies to every one of the three POSTs, because an awaited future
that never completes holds its request and its admission slot forever — a black-holed
endpoint would otherwise consume the whole `--max-in-flight` budget without a single invalid
request being sent.
